recommendations: Clarify substantive reuse permissions, applicable regulatory compliance, and confidentiality classification.
Document release-wide deidentification coverage, retained sensitive content, pediatric compensation, and cohort-specific assent and withdrawal procedures.
Specify released-artifact schema conformance, tabular status, and split or subpopulation subset roles.

issues_detected.description: Withdrawal and some assent provisions are quoted from the USF protocol, while the pediatric cohort was collected under a separate SickKids ethics approval. The record explicitly discloses this scope limitation, so those provisions were not treated as confirmed local procedures.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add SickKids-specific assent and withdrawal procedures when authoritative cohort-specific documentation becomes available.

semantic_insights: Human-subject participation is consistent with a named SickKids ethics review covering collection and sharing.
The consent statement agrees with the collection account: parental or participant consent preceded collection and covered sharing.
The description and instance entries consistently report 300 participants and 23,533 recordings.
Smaller counts for four feature files are expressly explained as feature-generation omissions, so they were not treated as conflicting cohort totals.
Version 1.1.0, its issue date, citation, and release history agree; the documented release dates are chronologically ordered.
The NIH award format and voice-biomarker purpose align, and the different supplement number is carefully separated from the dataset's stated award.
The distinction between registered feature access and controlled raw-audio access agrees with the statement that original recordings are excluded from the PhysioNet release.
Named processing software is connected directly to producing released features and merging phenotype data, satisfying the software-role criterion.
Protocol task lists and adult-dataset documentation are explicitly qualified rather than represented as verified pediatric release inventories.
Applicability was not inferred from the record: all conditional predicates remain unknown under the empty caller context, and all 50 items remain scored.
